{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows
display(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
missing_values = penguins.isnull().sum()
print("Missing values per column:")
display(missing_values)

# Check the dtype of body_mass_g
print("Dtype of body_mass_g:", penguins['body_mass_g'].dtype)

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999, 0, etc.) in body_mass_g
sentinel_values = [0, -999, -1, 9999]
for val in sentinel_values:
    count = (penguins['body_mass_g'] == val).sum()
    if count > 0:
        print(f"Found {count} instances of sentinel value {val} in body_mass_g")"}
